name: The Lodge at Blue Sky, Auberge Collection
positioning: A mountain resort on 4,000 private acres just beyond Park City, Utah, with creekside suites, an on-property whiskey distillery and a farm that supplies the kitchens
best_for: Couples who want adult-only creekside suites
Families who want connecting suites or a two-bedroom suite
Guests who want a secluded base for Park City skiing

facts.text: The Lodge at Blue Sky sits just beyond Park City and spans 4,000 private acres of wilderness.
The design is modern and organic, and cliffside accommodations overlook creeks and peaks.
The Creek Houses are one-bedroom suites on the banks of Alexander Creek, a short walk from the Sky Lodge and Edge Spa.
Each Earth Suite has a private terrace with an outdoor fireplace, and all offer connecting options for families.
The Two Bedroom Signature Suites are in the central Sky Lodge and suit families or guests wanting more space.
The resort is a 40-minute drive from Salt Lake City International Airport.
The High West Distillery is on the resort's property and offers whiskey tastings and distillery tours.
Gracie's Farm supplies eggs for breakfast dishes and honey for cocktails at The Bar.
Edge Spa is perched on a precipice overlooking Alexander Creek.
The resort has a private Ski Lounge at Park City Mountain Resort and can arrange ski transportation and equipment rentals.

highlights.text: The High West Distillery is on the resort's property and offers whiskey tastings and distillery tours.
Edge Sanctuary is a glamping tent in an aspen grove beside Alexander Creek, dedicated to energetic healing.
Gracie's Farm supplies eggs for breakfast dishes and honey for cocktails at The Bar.
The Tavern Breakfast Ride goes on horseback to The Tavern at Blue Sky, an original 1800s cabin where a Western-inspired breakfast is served.
Edge Spa offers vertical vinyasa, aerial yoga with silk hung from tree branches in a forest.

considerations.text: Private airport transfers can be arranged through the resort for an additional fee.
The Tavern Breakfast Ride is available from June to October.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires a drive to Park City center.
